about.title: About
about.description: Akili is a website and mobile application available on iOS and Android that helps fight misinformation, particularly in French-speaking Africa. Akili features a chatbot that allows users to verify information with just a few clicks and get an instant response, thanks to the use of artificial intelligence. But rest assured, Akili doesn't just use artificial intelligence to generate random results; we combine journalistic rigor with AI technology.
about.first_app: Akili is the first mobile application dedicated to fighting fake news in French-speaking Africa.
about.organization: The application is developed by Tama Média, La Voix de Mopti and Sétanal Média, with support from the International Organization of La Francophonie (OIF) as part of the "Twinning between Francophone initiatives to fight misinformation" project, of which the three media outlets were winners in 2024.
about.objective_description: Simplify and facilitate quick and fun access to fact-checking content because our general observation is that few people actually read fact-checking articles, using artificial intelligence as a tool to help fight false information.
about.mission_description: Raise awareness among local communities in French-speaking Africa about the dangers of misinformation and strengthen their ability to identify and counter false information.
